symptom: A session whose SessionStart hook failed to provision the app database ("no local PostgreSQL superuser available") looked like a healthy one: the hook runs `sh .claude/bootstrap-mxcli.sh || true` and the script ended in `exec ./mxcli run --local --setup --ensure-db`, so the failure was one line in hook output nobody reads and exit 0 (ChipCoV8/V9 bootstrap findings)
cause: `exec` handed the script's last word to mxcli, leaving the script no chance to react to the failure; `|| true` (correct — a hook must not block the session) then hid the status
insight: Keep `|| true` and move the loudness into the script: run without exec, tee the output to a log, keep the status in a file (a POSIX sh pipeline's status is tee's, and `cmd || echo $? >file` is the set -e-safe capture), then print an ERROR banner naming the last error line, the retry and `--db-type hsqldb`, and exit with that status. Test it by running the generated script under sh (dash here) with a stand-in mxcli whose `run` fails — the control (`run` succeeds) asserts no banner. Before the fix the failing case exited with the right status but printed no banner
